tests.title: A2 Key English Comprehensive Examination (CEFR / KET Standard)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR A2 assessment: Reading (5 passages, 30 questions), Listening (5 real-world scenarios, 25 questions), Speaking (2 tasks), and Writing (2 tasks).

tests.title: B1 Intermediate English Examination (CEFR / PET Standard)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR B1 assessment evaluating Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing based on Cambridge Preliminary (PET) standards.

tests.title: B1+ Applied English Proficiency Examination (Academic & Practical)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR B1+ assessment evaluating academic reading (neurobiology), workplace and daily listening dialogues, and practical communicative tasks.

tests.title: B2 Upper-Intermediate English Examination (CEFR / FCE Standard)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR B2 assessment evaluating Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing skills at the Cambridge B2 First (FCE) standard.

tests.title: C1 Advanced Academic English Examination (CEFR / CAE Standard)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR C1 proficiency examination assessing high-level academic Reading, Listening, Speaking, and formal Writing.

tests.title: C1 Advanced English Examination (CEFR / CAE Standard)
tests.description: Comprehensive CEFR C1 assessment evaluating Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing skills, focusing on complex academic argumentation, risk governance, and technological ethics.
